mood: Tactical Command Center, Competitive Elite Athleticism, High-Energy, Precision
core_principles: Context is King: Dashboards must feel like a pilot's control room (dense, precise); Marketing pages must feel like a stadium event (loud, immersive).
Contrast over Softness: No muddy grays. Use pure blacks, stark whites, and electrifying accent colors.
Technical Brutalism: Expose grids, use 1px solid borders instead of soft shadows.
Data as Art: Leaderboards and tournament brackets are the focal points of the UI, not afterthoughts.

rules.headings: NEVER use default sans-serif for headings. Bebas Neue must be used for H1/H2 to create a heavyweight, athletic feel. Always use uppercase.
rules.tracking: Display fonts must have tracking-normal or tracking-tight. Overlines/labels must be tracking-[0.2em].
rules.body: Outfit is geometric and clean, providing maximum legibility for dense dashboard metrics.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy combined with strict Grid alignment.

grids.marketing: Mode A: The 'Tetris' Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12). Wide gaps (gap-8 or gap-12). Aggressive asymmetry. Do not perfectly fill rows.
grids.dashboard: Mode B: The 'Control Room' Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Dense widget layout. Utilize every pixel.

layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the grid. Use border-r border-b border-white/10 on grid items to create a 'Technical Look' across dashboards.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Flat solid background (bg-[#121212]), sharp edges or max 4px radius (rounded-none or rounded-sm). 1px subtle border. NO soft drop shadows. On hover: slight upward transform (-translate-y-1) and border shifts to primary blue.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Primary: Solid #007AFF, pure white text, uppercase, tracking-widest, sharp corners. Hover state MUST invert or intensify (e.g., bg-white text-black). Secondary: Transparent with 1px solid white/20 border.
surfaces_and_components.inputs: Shadcn based. bg-[#0A0A0A], border-white/20, text-white. Sharp corners. Focus state: ring-2 ring-[#007AFF] border-transparent.
surfaces_and_components.headers: Sticky or fixed navigation. Must have background (e.g., bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Never leave it fully transparent over content.
surfaces_and_components.tables_leaderboards: Dense, highly structured. Left-align text data, right-align numerical stats. Use JetBrains Mono for numbers to ensure tabular lining.
surfaces_and_components.tournament_brackets: Connect matches with 1px solid lines (border-white/20). Active/live matches pulse with primary blue or accent red.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have defined hover states. Text color must be explicitly set on hover.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Minimalist and precise. Micro-interactions for button presses. No slow fades. Use framer-motion for bracket transitions.

icons.style: Duotone or bold weight for active navigation, regular for dense dashboard tables.

media_and_images.overlay_rule: Hero overlays must be max bg-black/50 or use a gradient to transparent. Never completely black out an image.

image_urls.description: Blue banners with team logos at an esports event. Use for Landing Page Hero section.
Young man with a game controller against a neon backdrop. Use for Portfolio/Profile placeholders.
Red and black esports jersey portrait. Use for Clan Management or Team Member showcases.
Active esports gaming studio with players. Use as a subtle, darkened background texture for the Game Community or Stats sections.
Colorful abstract patterns. Use for Tournament Organizer cover image or empty states.

rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use kebab-case, role-based names (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='tournament-bracket-node').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this entire JSON file thoroughly. You MUST strictly adhere to the Performance Pro Archetype.
2. For marketing pages, avoid standard Shadcn Card components. Use pure HTML/Tailwind to create sharp, asymmetrical 'Tetris Grid' layouts.
3. For the dashboard sections (Game Stats, Clan Management, Tournaments), use heavily customized Shadcn components (strip out soft borders, remove rounded corners, add 1px sharp borders).
4. Ensure Bebas Neue is applied to all major headings and Outfit for body text. Install these via Google Fonts.
5. Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons.
6. Every clickable item and form element must have a data-testid attribute.
7. DO NOT USE ANY PLACEHOLDER IMAGES (like via.placeholder.com). ONLY use the URLs provided in the media_and_images section.
8. Set up the Tailwind configuration to include the custom colors defined here: bg-obsidian (#0A0A0A), text-pure (#FFFFFF), accent-volt (#007AFF), accent-blaze (#FF3B30).
